posts.caption: Why your dog tilts its head when you talk.
posts.title: Why dogs tilt their heads

prompts.style: Warm storybook illustration, soft gouache colours, gentle light, simple background, vertical composition, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.say: Your dog tilts its head when you talk. Nobody is completely sure why.
scenes.image: A friendly golden retriever sitting on a living room rug, tilting its head to one side, looking curiously up at the viewer

scenes.say: It may help them place a sound, or see your face past their muzzle.
scenes.image: Close-up portrait of a brown and white dog with one ear lifted, listening intently, seen from the front

scenes.say: In one study, dogs that had learned toy names tilted far more when they heard them.
scenes.image: A small black dog tilting its head beside a basket of colourful plush toys on a wooden floor
